title: Could This Outspoken Arizona Senator Be the Dems’ Presidential Nominee in 2028?
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
Ever since his election to the Senate in 2024, **Ruben Gallego** , the junior
senator from Arizona, has been widely viewed as a major Democratic
[presidential contender](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2028-election/sen-
ruben-gallego-considers-2028-presidential-run-look-rcna265863) for 2028.

But can Gallego keep that momentum going, as President Donald Trump's
Department of Justice [investigates](https://www.axios.com/2026/06/29/gallego-
doj-investigation-campaign-finance) him for alleged campaign finance
violations? And after facing
[scrutiny](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/04/14/us/politics/gallego-swalwell-
congress-culture.html) for his relationship with disgraced Congressman Eric
Swalwell?

[Share](https://zeteo.com/p/gallego-tax-investigation-
ice-2028?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&action=share)

In this exclusive and wide-ranging 'Mehdi Unfiltered' interview, the senator
discusses it all with **Mehdi** , and says the Trump administration is
targeting him because they are **" afraid"** of him. Gallego also lays out his
populist vision for taxing the rich, warning that the U.S is fast becoming a
country **" that is largely led by, really, oligarch families."**

Here are the other major topics Mehdi and Gallego discuss in the interview:

  * Gallego's insistence on limiting _all_ billionaires' [influence](https://www.washingtonpost.com/elections/interactive/2026/06/25/these-are-biggest-individual-donors-2026-election-cycle/) over politics, including the Soros family

  * Whether the senator would vote to cut aid to Israel

  * The senator's record on immigration, including voting for the controversial and draconian [Laken Riley Act](https://www.npr.org/2025/01/22/nx-s1-5253926/congress-laken-riley-act)

  * Gallego's plan to 'tear down' ICE while also opposing the slogan 'Abolish ICE'

  * What the [victory](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jul/01/mamdani-new-york-democratic-socialist) of democratic socialists in Democratic primary races in New York and Colorado mean for the party

  * Whether he will consider running for president in 2028.
